pull.title: bip138: binary encoding clarifications
pull.body:
This PR clarifies a few details of BIP138's binary encoding.

It adds two test vectors in a new `payload.json`, but shouldn't be a breaking change.

Three middle commits:

- _specify empty associated data_: make the AAD input explicit in the encryption and decryption formulas.
- _clarify that 0x00 ends payload parsing_: add a test vector with a content item followed by a terminator and ignored bytes.
- _clarify rejection of empty payloads_: add a test vector containing only the terminator, with zero content items.

The first commit introduces a changelog. I'm reusing that commit across a few parallel pull requests.

The last commit updates the changelog; I'll update that depending on merge order.

labels.name: Metadata Update
labels.description: Changes to Changelog or Preamble without changing the technical content of a BIP.

labels.name: Fixups
labels.description: Minor fixups not worth bothering the BIP author(s) for

events.body:
cc @pythcoiner

First (changelog) commit is shared with #2298.
Changed from Fixup to BIP Update, because this seems to add another field to the encryption payload

>  add another field to the encryption payload

No, it just makes it explicit. All existing test vectors use an empty AAD.

Gotcha, thanks for clarifying, @sjors. Thanks for the review, @pythcoiner.

I rebased the PR on the latest commit in the master branch, because the initial Changelog had been added by #2298 which got merged earlier today. I resolved the conflict in the Changelog by moving the new Changelog entries to 0.1.2 incrementing from 0.1.1 which was reached by #2298.
